resolved_specific_review_findings.finding: A capture failure followed by cleanup SIGKILL could be classified only as an Android return-code failure.
resolved_specific_review_findings.resolution: Capture records whether an already observed nonzero or signal exit preceded the first capture error. Transport gives a true earlier capture/limit/timeout fault priority while preserving an already observed real exit failure. Two pure controls invoke the actual remember method before the explicit CompletedProcess seam.

resolved_specific_review_findings.resolution: Test root and case directory FDs are held. Known-file reads, stat and unlink use those parent FDs; directory removal requires named/held/original identity equality; all directory FDs enter close accounting and ambient-FD comparison.
